title: Parallel chain bench exports share one run folder, kept with the run record on disposal
steps: Start Brand and Planner concurrently with deterministic bench doors, write their real exported files, then dispose the chain.
expect: Both exports share the same run folder under the step records folder.
After disposal both exports are still there, with the run record beside them (ADR 0047, decision 5); cancellation remains supported.
A re-run writes into its own attempt folder, a record that cannot be written is logged as an error, and records in the temporary folder are warned about at startup (#591).
fence: Disposal keeps the run folder and writes the run record; it deletes nothing.

tests: parallel brand and planner exports share one run folder, and disposal keeps them with the record
a run that stopped before any step made a file still keeps its record
a re-run writes into its own folder, so the files of the failed attempt stay as they were
a record that cannot be written is logged loudly and fails the disposal, never silently
records in the temporary folder are warned about once at startup; a set folder is not
